messages:
anna-cs: Orchid customer reported regressions in p99 latency for completions and embeddings after weekend deploy. p95 stable ~220ms, p99 jumping to ~1.8s for some requests. Tenant: tenant_orchid_42. They shared sample request ids and screenshots. Can SRE pick this up? :wave:
sam-sre: on it. can you paste a representative time window + a couple req ids so I can pull histograms and node-level metrics?
anna-cs: started ~2024-06-15 03:12 UTC. sample req ids: 8a3b1, f9c2e. customer says intermittent but impacts search UX. they saw some 504s at the tail as well.
obs-bot: quick snapshot -> p95=230ms, p99=1.76s for tenant_orchid_42 (last 30m). host-06: CPU 95% spike, GPU util high, queue depth increased on node-06a.
sam-sre: thanks. initial look points to noisy neighbor on node-06 (other tenant running large batch embed jobs hitting same shard). I'll isolate tenant_orchid_42 to a different shard/priority lane and trigger quick reschedule.
lisa-eng: confirmed host metrics: frequent kernel stalls, elevated KV cache evictions. batching size jumped for an embed workload at ~03:10. likely interleaving of small chat requests + large embed batches -> tail amplification.
mike-eng: mitigation options (short term):
- temporary priority routing: tenant_orchid_42 -> priority=high (ttl 2h)
- reserve 2 GPU slots for tenant_orchid_42 for 1h
- fallback chat model variant with smaller context / lower batch-size
I can apply routing + reservation if we want immediate relief.
sam-sre: do priority routing + reserve 2 slots. patching now.
sam-sre: runbook command: curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/routing/override -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN' -d '{"tenant":"tenant_orchid_42","priority":"high","ttl_s":7200}'
deploy-bot: routing override applied by sam-sre at 2024-06-15T03:42:10Z :white_check_mark:
obs-bot: post-change snapshot -> p95=240ms, p99=420ms for tenant_orchid_42 (last 10m). queue depth down, CPU on host-06 normalized.
anna-cs: updated customer: explained temporary priority routing + reservation, they accepted. asked for a postmortem once we stabilize.
lisa-eng: recommend follow-ups: enforce soft-affinity to separate large-batch embed jobs from latency-sensitive lanes, add heuristics to limit batch-size for mixed-shard placements, and add tenant-level batch-size rate-limits.
sam-sre: opened INF-8423 for longer-term isolation + runtime scheduling fixes, assigning to eng-runtime and eng-ml for batching heuristics.
anna-cs: thanks all — I'll keep Orchids posted and collect their request traces for the postmortem. :thumbsup:
